front_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production reference for one image-to-3D game character RIGHT hand and short forearm. Show exactly ONE anatomically credible right human hand WEARING a fitted medium-brown leather glove, fingers upwards and short forearm downwards, centered on pure white background, entire object in frame with generous margins. Palm faces the camera in a mild 15-degree three-quarter view; thumb is on the viewer's RIGHT. This is a solid worn hand exterior, NOT an empty glove: no hollow wrist opening, no inner lining, no rolled rim, no flare, no cuff lip. Brown fitted leather continues smoothly from the wrist to the short proximal forearm; terminate at a simple flat cut plane below, no exposed flesh, no dark cavity, no decorative cap. Measured design proportions in millimetres, visually respected but NOT printed: wrist-to-middle-tip 185; palm across four metacarpals 75; wrist oval cross-section about 50 wide by 40 deep; proximal forearm section about 55 by 55; forearm coverage below wrist 80. Palm has natural smoothly rounded thenar and hypothenar volumes and readable continuous finger webs, not a broad flat star or a spherical balloon. Four fingers have relaxed slight forward flexion of roughly 10 degrees, separate clearly with small natural spacing, middle longest, ring and index slightly shorter, little shortest. Thumb has a broad anatomical thenar root, genuine saddle opposition volume, modest 40-degree abduction and slight palmward opposition; it does not stick straight sideways in the palm plane. All five rounded fingertips remain visible, no fused digits. Restrained thin dark-brown stitches follow glove panels away from joint flexion zones; smooth believable leather with subtle grain, no heavy sagging wrinkles or sharp ridges. Clean high-quality stylized 3D game-art render matching brown leather on an anime medieval swordsman; soft uniform diffuse studio light, neutral material colour, geometry readable from highlights not baked shadows. No steel, armor, sword, person, second hand, inset, grid, labels, dimension arrows, ground plane, cast shadow, lettering or watermark. Avoid bulky gauntlet, exaggerated palm thickness, wrist bag, hollow shell, extra fingers, flat paper-like shapes, dramatic lighting or cropped fingers.
